# 1. Points in High-Dimensional Spaces

::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills}

## Intro

I can say a few things. But can I

#### What is a Vector?

List of numbers, like features for a data point

#### What is a Vector Space?

Set of all possible lists of numbers. All possible feature values (but unconstrained).

#### What is a Subspace?

Maybe our data lies only in a subspace? Some features related to each other?

#### Why do we call it "Linear" Algebra?

Points could lie in a flat hyperplane or curved surface. Linear algebra is only concerned with flat hypersurface.
